The formula for the union of two sets is:
$$ |M \cup S| = |M| + |S| - |M \cap S| $$

*   $|M \cup S|$ is the number of students in at least one club (44).

$$ 44 = 28 + 21 - |M \cap S| $$
$$ 44 = 49 - |M \cap S| $$
